Haryana Guest Teachers Protest Outside Education Minister's Residence

Guest teachers in Haryana protested outside the residence of Education Minister Mahipal Dhanda, demanding the implementation of court orders regarding their regularization. The teachers gathered in Panipat, where they planned to surround the Education Minister's office. The protest centers on their demand to be made permanent.
